criterionType.description: Official category of the evaluation criterion as published by the funding provider.

necessity.description: Whether the criterion always applies, is conditional, or is recommended.

conditionGroupId.description: Optional reference to an eligibility RuleGroup that gates applicability of this criterion.

pointsMax.description: Explicit maximum points for a scoring criterion; null when not specified by the source.

weight.description: Explicit weight factor for weighted scoring; null when not specified by the source.

threshold.description: Explicit minimum score required to pass an elimination criterion; null when not specified by the source.

evidenceId.description: FieldEvidence reference anchoring this criterion to an immutable source document.

completenessStatus.description: Whether the criterion description is complete, partial, or unknown from the official source.

verificationStatus.description: Distinguishes official extracted fact from user input.

sortOrder.description: Deterministic ordering of criteria within a GrantCallVersion.
